coverage.basis: The team defines every month in this interval as covered for all three fictional sources. This does not describe official coverage.

severity.rule: F/I/N map directly. Native missing values map to __MISSING__; every other nonempty value is undefined and must block. These are fictional codes, not official classifications.

common_rules.missing_rule: Only native empty string and NULL mean missing in used fields. No NA, Unknown or numeric sentinel is declared. Unused columns remain native blanks and have no business mapping.
common_rules.keys: Keep exact text and component order, including leading zeros. Empty or all-whitespace keys block. C calls A's SQL key encoder; this generator creates no business keys.
common_rules.counts: Counts use nonnegative whole people or units as stated per field. Invalid integers and negative counts block. Any missing component makes its casualty sum NULL; never substitute zero.
common_rules.indicator_eligibility: A known severity gives fatal_crash_eligible=true. A known nonnegative fatality value gives fatality_eligible=true. All required casualty components must be known for casualty_eligible=true. Missing values retain NULL and a missing reason. Undefined definitions or values block.
common_rules.comparability: Deaths and casualties have the same fictional person definitions across these three sources; casualties include deaths. This permits S0 combined person totals only. NSW traffic units and VIC vehicles retain separate statistical scopes.
common_rules.dates: NSW and QLD have year/month precision; never add a day. Missing month with a known year gives year precision. VIC dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates. English month names use the fixed January–December table in 05 section 3.
common_rules.scope_filter: Resolve parent crash keys against the full native crash snapshot before applying the inclusive analysis years. A missing parent is an orphan, not an out-of-range record.
common_rules.location: Use each resource's CRS declaration and basis. Baseline S0 declares invented WGS84 longitude/latitude in EPSG:4326, with no datum transformation; a variant with a NULL declaration has unconfirmed CRS. Validate exact decimal coordinates before rounding; latitude must be -90..90 and longitude -180..180. Invalid, missing, conflicting or unconfirmed locations keep the crash but clear its projected coordinates, CRS and location reference, with the corresponding 05 reason.
common_rules.position_lineage: NSW/QLD use their crash raw row. VIC uses an eligible matching Node raw row. For equivalent duplicates choose by file hash, parser version and numeric original row position; keep every observation in Raw.
common_rules.bundle_basis: All seven files are generated together from this checked-in fictional definition. Each source's resource set is one complete compatible S0 snapshot; this is not evidence for any official bundle.
common_rules.snapshot_policy: First S0 is the baseline complete snapshot. Later corrections, removals or coverage reductions need an explicit source change statement; a smaller unexplained snapshot must block.
